# Communication

The Communication category has 4 tasks. Each entry shows the task's latest revision, the one the palette adds. See [Reading an entry](./overview#reading-an-entry).

## Send Email with Postmark Template

Send an email from a template using a template ID and variables.

- **Slug:** `send-email-with-postmark-template`
- **Type:** `template`
- **Revision:** 2
- **Image:** Default task image.

**Parameters**

| Label | Name | Type | Required | Default | Helper text |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| API Token | `token` | Secured | Yes |  |  |
| To | `to` | Text | Yes |  | Supports up to 50 recipients. Comma delimited. |
| From | `from` | Text | Yes |  | Email address or with name information |
| Template Id | `templateId` | Text | No |  |  |
| Template Alias | `templateAlias` | Text | No |  |  |
| Template Variables | `templateModel` | Text Editor - JavaScript/JSON | No |  |  |
| Tag | `tag` | Text | No |  |  |
| Message Stream | `messageStream` | Text | No | `outbound` | Message Stream ID that's used for sending |

**Results**

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `To` | Recipient email address |
| `SubmittedAt` | Timestamp |
| `MessageID` | ID of message |
| `ErrorCode` | See Postmark API Error Codes |
| `Message` | Response message |

## Send Email with Sendgrid
